notes:
Email searches no longer have a hidden time limit. "Who did I email?" can now see mail older than 90 days, and "mark all my marketing as read" covers your whole unread pile instead of the last 30 days. The agent also tells you which period it actually looked at, instead of turning "nothing in the last 90 days" into "you have no real emails".

Signing in works however you phrase it. "I want to sign in to twitter" now brings up the sign-in card instead of pointing you at the Connections tab, and the agent can raise that card itself for any account.
